OWNER-SET 08-18c, q=19.30 high. Owner's structural view: the top three are Gibbs, Bijan, Chase and should not move; he is content with McCaffrey at 4. Chase carried NO view before this - pi 18.88 and rank 6 were pure model output. The mechanical cause of rank 6 is that m(ADP) is IDENTICAL at 18.08 for every WR from ADP 3.1 to 10.2 (the isotonic curve is flat across the top of the board, so price separates nobody up there), leaving mu-hat to do all the work - and Chase's 2025 was 19.6 PPG, his weakest since 2023, in the season the h=1 likelihood weights most heavily. OWNER'S HYPOTHESIS TESTED AND NOT SUPPORTED: he asked to see Chase with and without Burrow. In 2025 Chase went 20.12 PPG in 8 games with Burrow vs 19.08 in 8 without - a gap of only 1.04, against 2023's 18.97/12.17 gap of 6.80. The 2025 dip is therefore NOT mainly a backup-QB artifact; he was down with Burrow on the field (20.12 vs 23.71 in 2024). Rebuilding mu-hat on Burrow-only games gives 20.86 and pi 19.11 - rank 5, not 4, so the adjustment alone does not deliver the owner's ordering. The view is therefore an explicit owner override of the recency signal, not a data correction, and is logged as such: if Chase repeats ~19.6 PPG in 2026 this view is wrong and must be recorded wrong.
